turnos.mensaje: How long does standard shipping usually take?

Standard shipping at Nerds Store usually takes 2 to 4 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Please note that we do not currently offer international shipping. If you have an order you'd like tracked, please share the order ID.
Thanks, that's helpful! Do you know if there's a cutoff time for orders to ship the same day?
I'm sorry, but the knowledge base doesn't include a same-day shipping cutoff time. For that, you can contact support@nerdsstore.example. Our business hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Got it, thanks for checking on that! Do you know if you offer free shipping, or is there a minimum order amount for it?
Yes, we offer free shipping on orders of $75 or more. Orders below that amount are charged shipping at the standard rates.
Great, that's really useful to know! Quick question: if I order something under $75, what would the standard shipping charge usually be?

I'm sorry, but the knowledge base doesn't include the standard shipping charge amount. For that information, please contact support@nerdsstore.example. Our business hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Got it, thanks! Last thing: do you happen to know if orders can be returned or exchanged if something doesn't fit or isn't what I expected?

I'm sorry, but the knowledge base doesn't mention exchanges. Our standard return window is 15 days. Clearance items aren't returnable, and opened headphones aren't returnable either. Damaged products must be reported within 7 days of delivery. For exchange questions, please contact support@nerdsstore.example.
Thanks, that's all really helpful! I think I've got what I needed. Have a great day!
You're welcome! Have a great day, and feel free to reach out anytime.
